mentions.name: Snibble
mentions.description: This daily word game combines snake, Scrabble, and PvP stealing, where players form words and can steal from each other. Recent work simplifies the mechanics, improves onboarding, and relaxes the visuals. The game has been tested with LLMs through a custom harness, and an upcoming release adds an LLM leaderboard with links to game replays.
mentions.problem: The game is too complicated, the onboarding is poor, and the aesthetic is too complex; current work fixes onboarding, relaxes the visuals, and simplifies the mechanics.
mentions.audience: People invited to try the game, give feedback, and suggest roadmap items
